defects.description: The film resistances are ignored (the exposed face is put at bulk-gas conditions), so the ignition and extinction points sit at the wrong Thiele modulus; the turning points are also read off a coarse grid without refinement.

The steady-state curve is sampled on a coarse grid of wall concentrations under the wrong boundary conditions, so narrow hysteresis loops (and the second loop of a four-fold curve) are missed or invented.

With the film ignored and the curve read off a coarse grid, the number of steady states at a given Thiele modulus is wrong where the exact curve has a loop the script does not see, and states beyond the grid's range are lost.

Stability follows the slope rule (middle state unstable, outer states stable). With a Lewis number below one the ignited state loses stability through a Hopf bifurcation, which only the linearised transient problem shows.
No transient analysis is done, so Hopf points (and the oscillatory instability between them) are never reported.
